title: Working beside Hunt's CIA colleague Arthur Hawkberg in Queens
place_text: Queens, New York; Robert Mullen Corporation, Washington, DC

tellings.quote: turns out to have been EH Howard Hunt's colleague at the the front that they worked for in Washington, DC.

plain: Around 1979 and 1980, in Queens, New York, the writer Peter Levenda says he worked beside a man named Arthur Hawkberg, who turned out to have been a colleague of the CIA officer E. Howard Hunt. Levenda tells Michels the two had worked together at the Robert Mullen Corporation in Washington, DC, which he calls a front, meaning a company used as cover for the CIA. If so, Levenda was working close to the CIA's world without knowing it.
